inference.plan_text:
Q1 locked analysis plan
Primary endpoint: allocative efficiency (η, percent) from cell_evidence.
Pairing: identical (seed, repeat); frozen_snapshot vs sequential_interaction.
Hypothesis: H0 median(η_sequential - η_frozen) = 0. Two-sided α = 0.05.
Test: Wilcoxon signed-rank, zeros dropped, average ranks for |d| ties,
normal approximation with continuity correction.
One primary endpoint. No other family-wise tests in this plan.
Effect size: Hodges–Lehmann median of pairwise averages of nonzero differences.
This archive's descriptive means were inspected before the plan was locked;
the p-value below is therefore post-hoc for run_1792582821581_6712.
inference.claim_boundary: Post-hoc Wilcoxon on paired η for this archive. Not a preregistered confirmatory test of a later campaign. Does not rank models or claim a causal activation-design effect beyond this sample.

matched_comparison.counterbalancing: Same seed and repeat; designs frozen_snapshot vs sequential_interaction; seat rotation by seed in engine.
matched_comparison.claim_boundary: Descriptive recomputation from archived files only. Mock transport is not Ollama inference. On-read JSON repair never rewrites archive bytes. Induced-value surplus counts only the first unit per seat, matching Market::metrics. Extra cash-financed units are recorded as trades but do not add redemption value. Paired frozen-vs-sequential differences are matched observations, not a causal ranking of models.
matched_comparison.scientific_gate_reason: Post-hoc Wilcoxon on paired η for this archive. Not a preregistered confirmatory test of a later campaign. Does not rank models or claim a causal activation-design effect beyond this sample.
